name: hive-monorepo
description: Hive suite controller: installs and manages the Hive:Magnus products from signed release manifests.
author: ChefTaco

scripts.bootstrap: npm --prefix services/hive-registry ci && npm run hooks:install
scripts.test: npm run test:ci && npm run test:install-scripts && npm run check:release-docs && npm run test:registry && npm run test:suite
scripts.test:ci: node --test scripts/ci-recovery-scope.test.mjs scripts/suite/recovery-timing.test.mjs scripts/suite/recovery-client.test.mjs && bash scripts/check-release-docs.test.sh && bash scripts/release/check-residual-risks.test.sh && bash scripts/release/upgrade-pair.test.sh && bash scripts/release/rollback-crossing.test.sh && bash scripts/ci-apt-setup.test.sh && bash scripts/suite/sudo-host.test.sh
scripts.test:install-scripts: node --test scripts/migrate-legacy-ardent.test.mjs && bash scripts/install-prerequisites.test.sh && bash scripts/console-certificate.test.sh && bash scripts/suite/console-certificate-service.test.sh && python3 scripts/suite/guided-setup.test.py && node --test scripts/suite/ardent-enrollment.test.mjs scripts/suite/ardent-setup.test.mjs && bash scripts/suite/ardent-setup.test.sh && bash scripts/suite/ardent-enrollment-controller.test.sh && node --test scripts/suite/node-enrollment.test.mjs scripts/suite/terminal-authority.test.mjs && bash scripts/suite/node-enrollment-controller.test.sh && bash scripts/suite/local-sudo.test.sh && bash scripts/suite/host-transport.test.sh && bash scripts/suite/rehearsal-resources.test.sh
